newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech prelim Sept real ind output up 7.0 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech prelim Sept real ind output up 7.0 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Czech preliminary real industrial output in September rose 7.0 percent, year-on-year, putting output 8.4 percent higher for the January-September period, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Monday.
INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT SEPT 96 AUG 96 SEPT 95 JAN-SEPT 96
AVERAGE INDUST WAGES SEPT 96 AUG 96 SEPT 95 JAN-SEPT 96

Note. Final September output/wage results are scheduled to be released on November 11. Wage results are taken from a survey of 210 firms with 100 or more employees. Production results also contain estimates from firms with up to 100 workers, as well as physical persons registered in the trades offices.
